key.name: auto-save-on-logout
key.description: Automatically save the session when logging out, restarting, or shutting down.

key.name: auto-restore-on-login
key.description: Automatically reopen applications and restore window positions on login.

key.name: restore-on-resume
key.summary: Restore session on resume from suspend
key.description: Re-apply window positions when waking from suspend.

key.name: restore-position
key.description: Move windows back to their saved screen position when restoring.

key.name: restore-size
key.description: Resize windows to their saved dimensions when restoring.

key.name: restore-workspace
key.description: Move windows to their saved workspace when restoring.

key.name: default-session
key.description: Name of the named session to restore by default. Empty string means the last auto-saved session.

key.name: save-session-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut to manually save the session

key.name: restore-session-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut to manually restore the session
